default.description: Without this file Tauri resolves an empty ACL, and every core command the window calls is denied. The one that matters is event:listen: the window registers its progress listeners at startup, and a denial there means a running transfer never appears on screen and a conflict can never be answered. The rest: the title bar follows the chosen theme. Updating lives in desktop.json, because phones have no updater.

desktop.description: Desktop only: an update can be fetched, installed and the app restarted into it. Phones are updated by their store.
